CustomObject.description: One record per board member per term of service (a term can span multiple fiscal years). Holds the member's board role, term start/end (expiration), status, and default annual giving commitment. "The current board" = Board Terms where Is Current = true. No Board object is used because JCRC tracks a single governing board (D13); add a Board__c lookup here later if a second body is ever tracked. JSI-123 Board Tracking. Author: Jason Ott.
CustomObject.label: Board Term
